# Graphify lab

> Fixed-version local code graphs, developer scenarios and one shared reference source/index per revision.

Tier: ungraded
Status: partial
Interfaces: cli, mcp
Entrypoint: python -m graphify_lab (reference CLI); python -m graphify_lab.workspace --source <directory> (local workspace CLI/stdio MCP)
Auth: none
Spec: none — experimental CLI with executable acceptance scenarios, not a network API

Code-only Graphify analysis. Source snapshots remain the evidence; the graph is a derived index. No hosted service or deployment. Mutable workspace commands revalidate source/configuration; stdio MCP serves its startup snapshot and must restart after edits.

## Interface reference

- [README](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/graphify-lab/README.md): execution commands and limits.
- [SUCCESS](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/graphify-lab/SUCCESS.md): acceptance status and evidence.

## Optional

- [SDD](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/graphify-lab/SDD.md): design and scenario contract.

- [Local workspace](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/graphify-lab/docs/local-workspace.md): explicit source, shared cache, source readback and snapshot MCP.

M4: workspace serve-live offers freshness checks, explicit refresh and directed calls-only paths. Original serve remains a fixed snapshot. See docs/local-workspace.md.

- [修改影響與測試線索](docs/milestones/change-impact.md)：serve-live 的 change_impact、calls 證據與有界 Python 測試 hints。

- [命令列分析](docs/milestones/cli-analysis.md)：workspace calls-path／impact 的JSON、退出碼及freshness契約。

- [節點來源與索引確認](docs/milestones/node-source.md)：CLI source-node／live MCP source_node，exact ID回讀及可選index_id保護條件。
